description: Screenshot of the Analytics page of the QMAP website (a Q-post aggregator), dark-themed, showing a dual line chart comparing monthly counts of 'QAnon Posts' (blue) and 'POTUS Tweets' (green) from Oct-2017 to Sep-2018. Tabs across the top offer Posts, Resignations, Executive Orders, Human Trafficking, and Sealed Indictments views. description: Composite screenshot pairing a Donald J. Red ovals circle the tweet's timestamp (10:30 AM - 20 Sep 2018) and the Q post's timestamp (09/20/18 10:29:42), implying the two were posted less than a minute apart — a 'delta' proof claim of coordination between Q and Trump.

Screenshot of Q drop #2222 (19 Sep 2018, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI) as rendered by a Q aggregator app with the editor-added headline 'Brett Kavanaugh Confirmation Linked to Rod Rosenstein and FEMA Presidential Alert System'. An anonymous poster asks whether moving the date of the POTUS FEMA 'Presidential Alert' test was significant; the drop replies that it was due to the Kavanaugh confirmation push and that '[RR]' (interpreted as Rod Rosenstein) would 'stand down due to K conf.' The drop's linkage of these events is the drop's claim.

description: Digitally composited meme: a photograph of museum visitors — several children and two adults seen from behind, seated on benches — viewing a large framed gallery painting into which a flaming letter 'Q' image has been edited. Text across the top of the 'painting' reads 'The greatest military intelligence operation of our time', a common QAnon slogan. The gallery artwork is not a real installation; the Q image is superimposed.
text: THE GREATEST MILITARY INTELLIGENCE OPERATION OF OUR TIME.
flags: Composited/edited image — the Q painting is digitally inserted into a museum photo
Children present in the photo; all persons remain unidentified
